title: CRM System Mastery & Sales Automation
description: This is a competency-based course designed for the indentured Technical Sales Representative apprentice. In-depth training on platforms for Customer Relationship Management, including GoHighLevel, Salesforce, HubSpot, and automation tools to optimize sales workflow.
learning_objectives: Explain how a CRM models a sale — objects, records, stages, and their relationships
Work leads and opportunities through a Salesforce pipeline correctly
Manage contacts, deals, and activity in HubSpot
Operate pipelines and campaign automation in GoHighLevel
Design an automation or workflow that removes manual steps from a sales process
Apply CRM hygiene rules that keep pipeline data trustworthy
Produce a defensible forecast from CRM opportunity data
prerequisites: Introduction to Sales (se101), or equivalent sales fundamentals
Mastering Outbound Prospecting (se202), for the lead flow this course records and automates

sequencing_rationale: The data model comes first (2) because every platform lesson afterwards is the same concepts under different names; the three named platforms (3–5) are then taught as variations rather than three unrelated tools. Automation (6) requires knowing what objects it acts on, hygiene (7) requires having entered data badly at least once, and forecasting (8) is last because a forecast is only as good as the hygiene that precedes it. SCOPE ASSUMPTIONS: the intake names GoHighLevel, Salesforce, and HubSpot plus automation tools, and gives 40 hours, so the platform lessons were sized equally (5 hours each) rather than favouring one vendor; the course teaches transferable CRM operation, not vendor certification, because catalog competency D3-S1-C04 is written tool-agnostically. Assumed in scope: rep-level and light admin-level configuration, workflow and sequence automation, data hygiene, and opportunity-based forecasting. Assumed out of scope: CRM development (Apex, custom objects at scale), integration engineering and API work, revenue-operations territory design, and analytics dashboards as an analytical discipline, which is se305's subject — lesson 8 stops at producing the forecast, not at diagnosing the funnel behind it.
